new_interface_contract.low_air: Select only deepest_frozen_node>1 and available_air<0.01. Block strictly frost_bottom<physical_drain_depth. If blocked zero scalar and bottom. Otherwise replace scalar with qbot for abs(raw)<1e-6, or retain raw*(1+qbot/raw). Modify conductivities with rfcp and original floor1e-10 and regenerate distribution using min(gwl,frost_bottom).
new_interface_contract.closure: Final low-air signed scalar is authoritative. Apply an explicit last participating node residual only for floating-point partition roundoff, diagnosed independently. Normal-air scalar is literal final nodal sum. One final nodal sink, separate bottom.
new_interface_contract.rejected_domain: Every nonzero raw or transformed scalar with abs<=1e-10 fails closed; zero is valid. No clipping or sign change. Invalid shapes/NaNs/geometry/physical controls fail closed before final publication.
new_interface_contract.bounded_geometry: Finite positive conductivity1e-10..1e6; dz1e-6..1e6; total profile depth<=1e6; anisotropy1e-6..1e6; spacing1e-6..1e6; |raw/bottom|<=1e6; groundwater within profile; separate-infiltration surface level above groundwater within profile, infiltration-depth factor0..1.
